_meta.status: ADOPTED (user-approved D1-D4 + weight lean; supersedes PARAMETERS_proposed.json)

anchor.weight_rationale: user leans SP+ (verified vintage, scale reference, interpretability); KFord gets the same 2x lean when it publishes (user's most-trusted source). Others diversify.
anchor.normalization: per source: z-score across its FBS coverage -> x SP+SD + SP+mean (points vs avg team)
anchor.od_split: blended overall, split into off/def using SP+'s component shape
anchor.mechanical_adjustments: NONE (churn priced by anchors - proven; power/G5 bias delivered via grades blend)
anchor.refresh_protocol: re-pull all live sources days before Week 0; re-date; log capture set per compute run
anchor.massey_decision: own model (composite would double-weight SP+/FPI which it ingests) - resolved 2026-07-13
anchor.fei_decision: IN the blend; compute-only, blinded from grading - resolved 2026-07-13
anchor.picksix_decision: CAPTURED 2026-07-14. Game Grader = retrospective results, not used; the 2026 prediction (overall rank of 68) is the anchor input, weight 1.0, P4 teams only - G5 teams simply average one fewer source.
anchor.picksix_weight_decision: stays 1.0 (2026-07-14): no measured accuracy basis; reviews != calibration; ordinal + P4-only. Revisit if historical Pick Six previews become available for backtest, or after 2026 misses are measured.

blend.k_rationale: recalibrated on competition-ADJUSTED grades (step4b, LOYO offsets): gamma solo +0.389 (t=+8.3), joint-with-class +0.322, threshold sens 0.32-0.39; 0.35 = middle, shade conservative for membership lookahead. Production grades live on the adjusted ruler, so k must be calibrated in that space.
blend.cap_rationale: adjusted residuals smaller (p90 |k x resid| ~3.8) - cap +-6 binds ~p99; tails linear (t=+8.1). Kept.
blend.class_term: anchor de-biasing, computed PER RUN: per_side = (3.49 - blend_tilt_vs_SPplus)/2. Today: G5 +1.68 / P4 -1.68. Auto-rescales when KFord joins. Basis: power coef -3.49 (t=-5.3) conditional on adjusted grades; independent churn-backtest estimate -3.8.
blend.flagged_not_adopted: class-specific k (P4 0.48 / G5 0.22) - revisit after pilot/season
blend.pilot_recheck: k/cap/class re-examined after two-team pilot and when August anchors land

variance.adopted: 2026-07-13 (user D1); overrides brief SS3 sanity scale, which portal-era data does not support

multipliers.data_confidence: set at grading time per snapshot flags

variance.dropped_multipliers: returning production, class - flat vs real misses
variance.note: band is epistemic-only; user's simulator injects game-level randomness

flagged_for_future.fcs_to_g5_coaches: +1.9 pts vs other coach changes, t=+1.3 (n=52) - underpowered for a mechanical adjustment; handled qualitatively in grading evidence; re-test after 2026
flagged_for_future.roster_membership_sensitivity: optional gamma re-measure with CFBD-roster membership (expected 0.25-0.30); not run

blinding_v2.forbidden: overall team ratings/rankings/projections/predicted finishes from anyone (anchor sources, Pick Six overall+order, magazine predicted finishes/national top-25s) + all market numbers
blinding_v2.allowed_mosaic_inputs: unit-level and player-level assessments from magazines and Pick Six, attributed + dated, never sole justification
blinding_v2.research_depth_mandate: obsessive standard adopted: mandatory source sweep (P4/ND: Steele+Athlon+PickSix; G5: Steele+Athlon), research_log.md incl. dead ends, per-unit dossiers, >=3 sources/unit, data_gap requires logged failed search
blinding_v2.note: richer grades likely carry MORE signal than the PFF-only calibration proxy -> k=0.30 stays conservative; pilot rechecks

grades_scale.ruler: exemplars v3 FINAL: percentile among 2025 FBS units AFTER conference adjustment
grades_scale.offsets_file: data/backtest/conf_offsets_2021_2025.json (full-sample; LOYO variant used only inside step4b calibration)
grades_scale.anchor_coherence_rule: global exemplar anchors require raw-vs-adjusted percentile gap <= 20 (guideposts must be intuitive; the discount table teaches the adjustment)

anchor_robustness.winsorize: source > 5 pts from median of other sources -> pulled to median +-5, logged
anchor_robustness.dispersion_flag: top-decile cross-source dispersion -> auto-flag for review pass
anchor_robustness.dispersion_band: x1.10 band multiplier for top-decile dispersion (judgment-based; calibrate when history exists)

outputs_spec.build_sheet: every team ships full derivation: 8 unit grades (w/ confidence + bracketing exemplars) -> learned conversion weights -> grade-implied off/def -> residuals -> per-source anchor values (raw + normalized + winsorized flags) -> blend -> class term -> k x resid (capped) -> ST -> final + band. Nothing opaque.
outputs_spec.overrides: outputs/overrides.csv (team, field, value, reason, date) - user-directed only, applied LAST, logged in run log, never silent. E.g. sided with Pick Six against blend on a team where its argument is strong.
